notes: Extracted 2026-10-15 from the official UGC PDF (ugc.ac.lk only). Numbers come from the PDF's text layer by column position (pdfplumber) and each row was re-read a second way: its value sequence must appear verbatim in an independent text extraction (pypdf) of the same page. Every row also passes its printed row total, and every table passes its printed column totals.

Cross-checks that pass: Table 2.4 programme totals (Merit + Other) equal Table 2.2 faculty totals; Table 2.4 Grand Total row equals Table 2.3 Total row district by district (44881 overall); Table 2.1 percentages recompute from qualified/admitted.
Totals: Tables 2.2, 2.3 and 2.4 total 44,881 admissions; Table 2.1 shows 44,852 admitted for 2023/2024 because its note (5) excludes 28 foreign-intake and 1 teachers-intake students.
Table 2.1's printed title reads 'Academic Years 2010/2021 - 2023/2024'; its columns actually cover 2020/2021 to 2023/2024 (G.C.E. A/L 2020-2023). Title kept exactly as printed.
Table 2.1 stream 'Other (6)': odd subject combinations introduced from G.C.E. (A/L) 2011 (note 6).

Table 2.2 notes: (1) Architecture/Quantity Surveying includes Design, Town & Country Planning, Landscape Architecture and Facilities Management. (2) Computer Science/IT includes Management & IT, IT, ICT, IT and Management, Artificial Intelligence, Business Information Systems, Information Systems, Computer Science and Technology, Electronics and Computer Science, Accounting Information Systems etc. (3) Allied Health Sciences includes Nursing, Pharmacy, Medical Laboratory Sciences, Radiography, Physiotherapy, Speech & Hearing Sciences, Occupational Therapy, Optometry, Indigenous Pharmaceutical Technology and Yoga and Parapsychology. (4) Agriculture includes Urban Bioresources, Aquatic Bioresources & Multidisciplinary Studies (Faculty of Urban & Aquatic Bioresources, University of Sri Jayewardenepura). (5) The Institute of Indigenous Medicine became a Faculty of the University of Colombo in 2023, so Colombo(5) includes Indigenous Medicine.

Table 2.2 institution letters: all 20 printed institution columns map to FindMyWay letters (from data/ugc/2025-2026/unicodes.csv): Colombo(5)=A, Sri Palee Campus=S, Peradeniya=B, Sri Jayewardenepura=C, Kelaniya=D, Moratuwa=G, Jaffna=E, Ruhuna=F, Eastern=H, Trincomalee Campus=W, South Eastern=J, Rajarata=K, Sabaragamuwa=L, Wayamba=M, Uva=U (Uva Wellassa), Visual and Performing Arts=Z, Gampaha Wickramarachchi=P, Vavuniya=R, University of Colombo School of Computing=T, Swami Vipulananda Institute=Y. The 'Total' column has letter null.

Table 2.3 is per programme name, not per university: a programme offered at several universities (e.g. 'Medicine', 'Engineering', 'Management') is one row summed across all of them, so most rows have letter null. Letters are set only where the printed name carries an abbreviation from the table's note (2) that names one institution (SP=S, SAB=L, SEUSL=J, UVPA=Z, SVIAS=Y, UJA=E, KLN=D). Unmapped on purpose: '(TV)' = Trincomalee Campus AND University of Vavuniya (two institutions, W and R); '(SJP)' in 'Music (SJP)' is not defined in the note (very likely University of Sri Jayewardenepura = C, not asserted); '(Ramanathan)' is not defined in the note (Ramanathan Academy of Fine Arts, University of Jaffna, not asserted); '(TM)' Textile & Clothing Technology and '(EM)' Earth Resources Engineering name programmes, not institutions.
Table 2.3: the programme 'Computing & Information Systems' (PDF page 10) is printed with no numbers at all; it is left out of rows.

Table 2.3 keeps printed spelling, including typos: 'Data Sciene', 'Management & Information Technoogy-KLN', 'Management & Information Technoogy-KLN-Bio', 'Drama & Theatre ( UVPA)(2)'. Names printed over two lines are joined with one space.

District keys use FindMyWay's spelling (as in data/ugc/2025-2026/cutoffs_2025_2026.csv). The printed headers differ ('Kilinochi', 'Kurunegla', 'Vauniya', 'Rathnapura'); see districtColumnsAsPrinted per table.

Special & Additional Intakes (note 1 of Tables 2.3/2.4): students admitted under special categories (blind and differently abled, excelled in fields other than studies, armed forces, foreign, teachers, etc.) on the recommendation of the Appeals Committee, plus the additional intake for special subjects such as Japanese, English, History.

Table 2.4 note (3): admission to Arts is purely on merit, but policy ensures the number admitted from a district is not less than the number admitted from that district in 1993/94 or 2002/2003, whichever is greater; this adjustment is shown under 'Other'.
Not extracted (not useful for choosing a course): Table 02 - 05 (admissions by programme, institution and ETHNICITY, PDF pages 20-22) and Charts 01-06 (graphics only).
Caution for the app: these are 2023/2024 intake counts, published by UGC; they are not quotas or proposed intakes for later years.
